blocks.text: Stanford University is offering a course on mental health and well-being inspired by BTS leader Kim Namjoon, better known as RM. Titled “Namjooning, and Other Well-Being Inspiration From BTS,” the course is listed under Psychology 65N (PSYC 65N) as a three-unit introductory seminar for the 2026-2027 academic year. According to the course description on Stanford’s website, the class will draw inspiration from RM’s approach to mental health and well-being, as well as activities and interests associated with him, collectively known among fans as “Namjooning.” The term refers to RM’s appreciation for nature, biking, art, and literature, among other activities.
